title: Western US Event
doc_notes: This document is a collection of slides detailing UAP sightings by federal law enforcement agents in the Western U.S., and it contains multiple close-approach encounter reports.

encounters.summary: Federal agents observed a glowing orange orb hovering near a rock pinnacle, appearing to have a spindle connecting it to the rock.
encounters.quote: did almost appear it might have had a small spindle or something connecting it from underneath to the rock formation

encounters.summary: Federal agents pursued an object resembling a dark kite with two lights that moved laterally over the desert with zero resistance.
encounters.quote: it almost looked like an ill defined, dark kite shape that had some rounded width to the sides

encounters.summary: Federal agents observed a transparent, kite-shaped object floating near the ground; a spotlight beam appeared to be blocked by an invisible barrier.
encounters.quote: at one point my beam went from shining far into the distance to stopping about 50 yards away on nothing in particular
